items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: Eddie used to talk this, and he and that girl vocalist, big girl -- chick she was from Birmingham, Alabama, named Jean Cunningham. They used to do this thing and played it up.

ctx.x: So -- real funny -- and he was quite a bass player. Eddie Calhoun was -- and he was quite a comedian. In fact, there's a friend of mine that wrote a tune called -- I collaborated with him on that -- called Shack in Hackensack. " Real funny, you know? And Eddie used to talk this, and he and that girl vocalist, big girl -- chick she was from Birmingham, Alabama, named Jean Cunningham. They used to do this thing and played it up. He was a little runt, and she was tall and used to stand under him. And besides doing…

So he had one already made up that you didn't have to bother with the piano, putting that bar behind. He had the regular keyboard that was sawed off, up to only so many octaves. And it was all a compact unit, you know. I've got it downstairs.
